decision: Authorize exactly one file beyond the F05 write scope of src/epistemic_foundry/evolution/v4_f05/**: the package marker src/epistemic_foundry/evolution/__init__.py. It contains a docstring only and declares no vocabulary, no API and no behaviour. This mirrors HD-EF4-E05-SCOPE-20260802-001 for the effects package and authorizes nothing beyond the single marker. F05 otherwise writes only under its granted scope and artifacts/work_packages/F05/**, reads its node vocabulary from workflows/evolution_chamber_cycle.workflow.yaml and its stop vocabulary from evolution_chamber/checkpoint.py, and holds no canonical schema enum value as a string literal.
rationale: pyproject.toml discovers packages with setuptools find_packages (where = ['src']), which requires __init__.py at every level. The same condition was verified empirically for the effects package under HD-EF4-E05-SCOPE-20260802-001: without the marker, find_packages returns nothing for the nested package while find_namespace_packages finds it, so the module imports from a source checkout but is absent from the built wheel. That is the source/dist divergence the sealed B04 build gate exists to prevent. Changing the discovery mode in pyproject was rejected again: pyproject is B04's sealed territory and switching the project to namespace discovery for one package would alter packaging behaviour repository-wide. The F05 attempt carries a packaging-discovery check that proves the package stays discoverable.
